sourceOfAuthority: Leader, 2026-10-21: "we want to normalize the names, x-engineering-services-section, x-science-services-section, etc., or just, the straight app or library name. everything proper submodules, and preferably with real repo and packages to help us manage and enforce these norms." House rule every-repository-package-and-section-has-one-home: a section, its package and its repository are one unit, and the directory that composes it is named for its repository.

layout.sourceOfAuthority: The services section form (561-group-services-section data/records/schemas/services-section-form.schema.json, laws contentUnderContentText and dataTrioOnly, and services-section-form-content-taxonomy.json): every section, package and unit shares one recursive directory layout. `standard` lists the directory names that form states for each position (its knownTopLevelNames, recognized content roles, contentTaxonomyPaths, dataTrioNames and relocation targets); the census proposes them as canonical. Each relocation is one ruling: `from` is a path variant and `to` the canonical path, both relative to the same directory at any depth of a repository. A relocation with `hold` is reported by the check and the census and refused by the fix.
